description: This file is a shell script for testing rename detection in git. It sets up test cases, runs git diff commands, and compares outputs to expected results to verify rename and copy detection behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs specified commands, and compares output against expectations.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the current diff output with the expected diff to validate correctness.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
